verdict.rationale: Adyen documents testing transaction types with test credentials (docs-15). The client-key docs refer to keys scoped per environment (docs-26), which implies separate test and live environments. The evidence is thin, though: it never explicitly describes an isolated sandbox for the platforms product (balance platforms, onboarding, payouts) or confirms separation from production data. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a test environment isolated from live data, platform-specific sandbox coverage (onboarding/payouts/splits in test), agent/MCP use against test, and independent hands-on corroboration.
